name: The Keys System - Tri-Core AI
description: A powerful AI interface with tri-core architecture supporting GPT-4, Claude, and Gemini

VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for GPT models (get from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)

VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for Claude models (get from https://console.anthropic.com/)

VITE_GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY.description: Google AI API key for Gemini models (get from https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey)

scripts.postdeploy: echo 'Deployment successful! Make sure to set at least one API key (VITE_OPENAI_API_KEY, VITE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or VITE_GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY) in the Heroku dashboard.'
